name: Wilbury Theatre Group Summer Camp: Tall Tales of the Smallest State
description_short: A one week theater camp for ages 8 to 10 where kids turn true Rhode Island history stories into short comic plays using clowning, improv and movement, ending with a Friday show for families.

sessions.name: Tall Tales of the Smallest State

notes: Led by Mycah Hogan, Wilbury's Director of Education. No auditions or experience needed.
